skills.name: conversation
skills.description: Respond to Discord messages using Gemini with memory context.

skills.name: memory
skills.description: Persist learned facts and per-user chat history under data/.

skills.name: task_automation
skills.description: Manage recurring scheduled tasks with custom prompts via natural language or !task commands.

skills.name: financial_self_learning
skills.description: Ask Gemini financial SET-learning questions every 10 minutes, store Q/A knowledge files, and reuse them in future answers.

skills.name: daily_reports
skills.description: Generate and post a scheduled daily report to the configured Discord channel.

skills.name: set_financial_data
skills.description: Fetch SET stock quote and financial statement data with !setfinancial or !setbalance.

skills.name: set_financial_analysis
skills.description: Quick financial health analysis on SET stocks: D/E ratio, equity ratio, cash/liabilities score with 🟢/🟡/🔴 verdict.

skills.name: stock_finance
skills.description: Real-time global stock price and sector lookup via !stock <TICKER> using yfinance.

skills.name: web_scraping
skills.description: Scrape website content for automation tasks using the url parameter.

skills.name: runtime_grounding
skills.description: Report runtime and Docker facts from physical files and container state only via !runtime, !docker, !compose.

skills.name: docker_control
skills.description: Run docker and docker compose commands via Discord for allowed user.

skills.name: path_verification
skills.description: Check and verify workspace file paths before and after self-upgrade operations.

skills.name: self_improvement
skills.description: Modify the workspace with !improve or !upgrade by creating, updating, or deleting text/code files safely.
